name: personal-db-plugin
description: Local-first personal SQLite database tooling for OpenClaw agents.

interface.shortDescription: Give OpenClaw agents a local SQLite store for personal data.
interface.longDescription: A local-first personal database plugin for OpenClaw. It gives agents a safe CLI for creating schemas, adding and searching entities, tracking facts/events/tags/text, and building domain tables such as reading lists, hikes, meals, and workouts without bundling private user data.
defaultPrompt: Add this article to my reading library.
Search my personal database for hikes.
Create a table for tracking workouts.
